turns.content: Hi! My name is Dana. I work at Northwind Labs as a data engineer and I am allergic to peanuts, so keep that in mind if you suggest recipes.
Nice to meet you, Dana. I will avoid peanuts in any recipe suggestions.
I just moved to Boston, renting near Kendall. My favorite cuisine is Thai and I love garlic in almost everything I cook.
Congratulations on the move to Boston. Kendall Square has several good Thai places within walking distance.
Can you give me a simple pasta recipe for tonight? I have tomatoes, basil and parmesan at home.
Start by boiling salted water, then cook the pasta while you crush the tomatoes with garlic and olive oil.
I made the tomato pasta again and added extra garlic, it was great. Could you suggest a dessert without nuts?
A lemon posset needs only cream, sugar and lemon and contains no nuts.
I am debugging a segfault in my C++ project at work today and it is driving me crazy.
Run the binary under valgrind or AddressSanitizer to find the invalid memory access first.
I cooked the garlic tomato pasta for friends and everyone asked for the recipe. I also tried the lemon posset.
Glad it went well. You could try adding roasted cherry tomatoes next time.
My cat Milo is turning three next week and I want to bake him a small treat.
A tuna and oat biscuit is safe for cats and easy to bake.
I have been running along the Charles River every morning this month. I signed up for a 10k in June.
A 10k in June gives you about eight weeks; a gradual plan with one long run a week works well.
Can you help me draft an email to my landlord about ending the Boston lease early? I might be relocating for work.
Here is a draft: Dear landlord, I am writing to discuss ending my lease early due to a work relocation.
I moved to Seattle this week because of a company transfer. I now work at Northwind Labs Seattle office.
Welcome to Seattle. Let me know if you want neighbourhood suggestions near the office.
I ran the 10k this morning in 52 minutes. Milo handled the move fine.
Congratulations on the 10k, 52 minutes is a solid time.
